title: "Possible Sync Problem" pop-up - What is the solution when the followers are working perfectly?
symptom: Users report a 'Possible Sync Problem' pop-up appearing repeatedly, even when followers are working perfectly. The pop-up occurs in xDrip and may be related to having had a smart watch that is no longer active.
cause: The thread suggests the problem is due to Google, but the exact root cause is not fully established. It is suspected to happen when someone has had a smart watch that is no longer active.
fix: Enabling 'Desert Sync' stops the pop-up, but it is described as a crude work-around, not a solution. Disabling 'Be master for followers' also stopped the pop-up for one user without followers.
evidence_quote: Based on that, if "Desert Sync" is enabled, the pop-up will never show up. I asked them to enable Desert Sync. They did and the pop-ups stopped.
